purpose: Consolidate the approved-main post-Pilot #20 Q1-Q6 provider-free evidence into the current machine-readable qualification state. This transition permits only the bounded Q7 live worker soak after same-head assurance and Founder-approved merge; it does not restore full-course confirmation eligibility.

evidence: docs/technical/Content Factory Q1 Contract Ownership Qualification.md
Q1-compiler-worker-ownership-inventory.conclusion: The post-Pilot #20 candidate-recovery topology has a complete course-agnostic ownership inventory. Slot identity, candidate sequence and ceilings, disposition, accepted-artifact freezing, exhaustion and required-coverage reconciliation are Revision-owned mechanical controls; semantic educational content remains generative judgement where appropriate.

Q2-historical-failure-replay-corpus.conclusion: The immutable Pilots #1-#18 corpus and Pilot #19 evidence remain intact, while Pilot #20 is represented by a labelled synthetic replay proving complete diagnostics, same-slot replacement and explicit bounded exhaustion without silent omission.

Q3-adversarial-provider-free-subject-mat.conclusion: All five governed subject shapes exercise the production Assessment/Marking recovery topology, including Assessment and Marking candidate replacement, accepted-sibling survival, frozen dependencies and fail-closed exhaustion.

evidence: docs/technical/Content Factory Q4 Candidate Recovery Qualification.md
Q4-deterministic-full-pipeline-simulatio.conclusion: The provider-free production-path simulation can reject and replace Assessment and Marking candidates, preserve accepted work, reconcile mandatory coverage and reach expert_review_ready; bounded exhaustion blocks instead of manufacturing an incomplete course.

Q5-restart-reuse-dependency-invalidation.conclusion: Candidate-aware restart and exact-terminal reuse preserve unaffected accepted work, while semantic changes invalidate only the affected stage and genuine downstream dependants rather than forcing universal regeneration.

Q6-repeated-provider-free-stability.conclusion: The current Q2-Q5 recovery topology passes three deterministic shuffled repetitions with the historical corpus and adversarial matrix retained.

limitations: Q1-Q6 provider-free PASS is process and contract evidence, not educational benchmark evidence and not live-provider evidence.
This consolidation does not modify the Q7 request file and therefore does not itself initiate any provider call or spend.
Q7 remains required and may expose a new generic contract class; any such finding returns the affected gates to requalification before another soak.
Full-course confirmation remains prohibited until Q7 is PASS and a separate Founder-approved Q8 transition changes the overall machine status to qualified.
Historical Pilot #19, Pilot #20 and earlier Q7 evidence remain unchanged and historical.
